headline: I build the systems your business runs on.
tagline: Software engineer building reliable products end to end: backend services, fast interfaces and cloud infrastructure, with the language the problem calls for, and growing into AWS, DevOps and cloud-first development.
about: I started in technology at 18 as a deliberate, non-traditional choice, and it became the center of my life. I learn fastest where things are hardest: a tough technical bottleneck is, for me, a playground.
I have led the migration and modernization of fintech and accounting SaaS platforms, designed backends in NestJS and ASP.NET Core, and shipped fast interfaces with React, Next.js and Astro.

I care about understanding what the business needs and choosing the simplest architecture that solves it. I work across the stack (backends in Java, Kotlin, Go, TypeScript and C#; interfaces in Angular, React and Astro) and pick the tool for the problem, not the other way around. I’m growing into AWS, infrastructure as code and DevOps to build cloud-first.

stats.label: APIs, interfaces and cloud, using the language the problem needs
